reason_statement: The instrument that produces the measured population is itself defective, and the defect was proven while the window was open. G8 measures whether a DELIVERED health finding provokes a matching operator action. The health-check emitted an age-blind annotation-backlog warning into that population 15 times after T0, and at every one of those emissions the genuinely-overdue count was ZERO. The population is therefore not a sample of health findings the operator ought to have acted on; it is padded with alarms the instrument should never have raised. This is NOT an argument about an unmerged branch hash — a waiting branch changes nothing in production. It is that the running instrument was measured and found wrong.

age_blind_annotation_warning_proof.statement: The annotation-backlog warning had no age filter at all. The auto-annotator may not touch an alert for its first 4h (_DEFAULT_MIN_AGE_HOURS) and runs every 6h, so freshly dispatched alerts were counted as backlog on arrival.

population_affecting_changes_in_stab_fin: app/alerts/health_check.py — annotation-backlog block becomes age-aware; changes HOW MANY health findings are emitted, i.e. the emitted population itself
app/alerts/health_check.py — YouTube reason SQL splits pre-instrumentation rows from live defects; changes the wording and severity framing of an emitted finding
app/alerts/health_notify.py — per-finding ACTIVE->CLEAR recovery; adds a class of delivered message that did not exist during the window
other_truth_defects_proven_during_the_wi: timer card reported '10 OK' from a snapshot that was structurally stale 22h of 24 (flat 2h budget against a once-daily producer); installed timers are 56, not 10
67 envelopes rendered as position_open although a position_closed event existed
priority label 'HIGH-CONVICTION' granted while the measured tier lift is -7.4pp
five dashboard percentages published with no stated population or denominator

not_done.note: Kein Evaluator gelaufen, kein acted-Count gelesen, kein Zwischenergebnis genommen. Der emitted-Strom wurde ausschließlich insoweit eingesehen, wie der Nachweis des Instrumentendefekts es verlangte (15 Emissionen der altersblinden Warnung); dieses Ergebnis dient allein dem Verwerfen des Fensters, nie seiner Deutung.

successor.rule: No placeholder id. The successor prereg_id is derived from the DEPLOYED code (mainline SHA + evaluator sha256 + health_notify sha256 + effective config sha256) and cannot be known before the deploy. #843 already established why a pre-computed id is dangerous.
successor.allowed_transition: INVALIDATED_PENDING_SUCCESSOR -> INVALIDATED_BEFORE_MEASUREMENT, and only then replaced_by = <id computed on deployed code>. invalidated_at_utc stays 2026-09-01T20:38:51Z and is NOT moved to deploy time.

correction.reason: Der Beleg widersprach sich selbst: not_done.emitted_count_inspected=false und "No count of any kind was read." standen neben post_t0_emissions_observed=15, auf die sich das reason_statement stuetzt. Ein Instrumentendefekt laesst sich nur nachweisen, indem man ansieht, was das Instrument ausgesendet hat - das ist legitim, die Formulierung war es nicht. Korrigiert wird die BEHAUPTUNG, nicht die Entscheidung: invalidation_decided_at_utc, reason, substantive_verdict und die Replay-Zahlen bleiben unveraendert.
